SlayTheDungeon:PressureIndicator.NAME: Pressure Indicator
DESCRIPTIONS: Displays the party's current Stress. Taking unblocked damage also inflicts Stress.

SlayTheDungeon:BrightnessIndicator.NAME: Brightness Indicator
SlayTheDungeon:BrightnessIndicator.FLAVOR: The light has not yet faded.
DESCRIPTIONS: Displays the current Brightness. Higher Brightness reduces damage and Stress taken, but also reduces gold and the chance of positive effects.
